title: AMS Mobile App
summary: Improve antibiotic use in your hospital with an AMS assessment. A mobile app that guides healthcare professionals through assessing their Antimicrobial Stewardship Program and delivers Pfizer certificates for hospitals.

blocks.title: Goal & Scope
blocks.body:
Design a user interface for a mobile app that guides healthcare professionals through an assessment of their Antimicrobial Stewardship Program (ASP).

The project focused on an intuitive, user-friendly UI that walks users through a comprehensive assessment, highlighting areas of strength and identifying opportunities for improvement.

blocks.title: 01 — Competitive Analysis
blocks.body: We analyzed existing indirect competitors to identify their strengths, weaknesses and potential areas for improvement in the proposed app.

blocks.title: 02 — Ideation
blocks.body: Using the “Crazy 8s” technique, we rapidly generated a diverse range of UI concepts and functionalities within a time-boxed session.

blocks.title: 03 — UI Design
blocks.body: Based on the insights from the previous phases, we designed the app's interface for clarity, intuitiveness and a seamless assessment experience.
